waivers.reason: Unmaintained build-time parser of bundled i18n.toml from age's localization macros; no LayerAgent workspace, web, MCP or archive input reaches this parser. Latest i18n-config 0.4.8 still requires it. This waiver covers maintenance status only; it does not waive a vulnerability advisory. Review by 2027-01-20.
